Package ro.ase.ppoo.ebanking.model

Class ContBancar

java.lang.Object
ro.ase.ppoo.ebanking.model.ContBancar
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<ContBancar>
public class ContBancar extends Object implements Serializable, Comparable<ContBancar>
Entitatea ContBancar gestioneaza datele de identificare, soldul si starea unui cont bancar deschis pe numele unui titular.
